HEAT ILLNESS SIGNS & SYMPTOMS:

• Muscle cramps • Heavy sweating • Nausea/vomiting • Headache

• Dizziness/fainting • Weakness/fatigue • Cool clammy skin • Rapid pulse

• Confusion • Hot dry skin • High body temp • Loss of consciousness

HEAT ILLNESS EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

1. Move athlete to cool/shaded area

2. Remove excess clothing/equipment

3. Cool athlete rapidly (cold water immersion if possible)

4. If conscious, provide cool water/sports drink

5. If unconscious or altered mental status, activate EMS

6. Stay with athlete until help arrives

Lightning Safety Policy

LIGHTNING SAFETY PROCEDURES:

• Monitor weather forecasts before activities

• Designate weather watcher for all outdoor activities

• Use lightning detection device or "Flash-to-Bang" method

• Establish safe shelter locations

• Suspension criteria: Lightning within 10 miles or flash-to-bang < 30 seconds

• 30-30 Rule: Seek shelter when flash-to-bang < 30 seconds, wait 30 minutes after last strike

• Resume activity 30 minutes after last lightning/thunder

• Have communication plan to notify all participants
